title: IM60024: Advanced Production Planning And Inventory Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: IM31007 Production Planning and ControlHierarchical Production
Planning: Concept and algorithms, Disaggregation and hierarchical co
ordination, Lot size scheduling in single and multi stage production systems.
Distribution requirement planning: concepts and methods. Sequencing of jobs
through single machines: Basics, General purpose and special purpose methods,
Flow shop and Job shop scheduling, Simulation of dynamic job shop, FMS
scheduling issues and methods, Special algorithms for shift scheduling, Vehicle
routing, computer operations and health care delivery.Books1.S.L. Narasimhan,
D.W. Mc Leavy, and P.J. Billington, Production Planning and Inventory Control,
PHI, 2nd Edition.2.R.Peterson, and E.A. Silver, Decision Systems for Inventory
Management and Production Planing, John Wiley and Sons.3.C.C. Holt, F.
Modigliani, J.F. Muth, and H.A. Simon, Planning Production, Inventories, and
Workforce, Prentice Hall, NJ.
